schemes.title: Sikkim GO — State e-Services Single Sign-On
schemes.department: Department of Information Technology, Government of Sikkim
schemes.brief: Sikkim GO is one login for the state's online services — certificates of identification, income, and other departmental applications. You register once and use the same account for whatever department you need afterwards.
schemes.benefit: One login for Sikkim's certificates and departmental services
eligibility: Resident of Sikkim, applying in the district where the family lives
A Certificate of Identification is issued to those whose families are recorded in the Sikkim Subject Register or its successor records
An income certificate is valid for one year
A mobile number linked to Aadhaar, since the account is confirmed by OTP
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Certificate of Identification of a parent, where claiming one
Ration card of the family
School certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Electricity bill or rent agreement for the address
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Certificate of Identification, income, residence or a departmental service. Each opens its own form once you are logged in.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family; essential for a Certificate of Identification, which runs through the father's record.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Sub-division / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Sub-Divisional Magistrate of this sub-division signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Parent's Certificate of Identification number
demoFields.hint: Where you are claiming a Certificate of Identification, the parent's number is the paper that decides the case.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Recorded for the file. It does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register once on sso.sikkim.gov.in with your Aadhaar and mobile, and confirm the OTP. The same account then works for every department.
Choose the service and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card.
Upload the documents. For a Certificate of Identification, the parent's certificate is the one that matters most.
Submit, pay any fee, and note the application number.
The block or sub-division staff verify the family, then the Sub-Divisional Magistrate signs.
Download the signed certificate from the same login, and check the spelling of names before relying on it.
schemes.helpline: Your Sub-Divisional Magistrate's office, or the district administrative centre

schemes.title: Sikkim Public Service Commission Recruitment
schemes.brief: The Sikkim Public Service Commission recruits for the state civil service and for the gazetted and non-gazetted posts of the state departments. Applications are filed on its own online recruitment system.
schemes.benefit: One online profile for every Sikkim PSC recruitment
eligibility: Holder of a Sikkim Subject Certificate or Certificate of Identification, for most state posts
Age as the advertisement states, usually 21 to 30 for the civil service, with relaxation for reserved categories
The qualification the advertisement requires, complete on its closing date
Knowledge of a Sikkimese language as the advertisement specifies for some posts
documents: Certificate of Identification or Sikkim Subject Certificate
Aadhaar card
Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Degree certificate and marksheets
Category certificate, where claiming a reservation
Employment exchange registration, where the advertisement asks for it
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Post applied for
demoFields.hint: One application per advertisement. Read the qualification and age limit in that advertisement before paying.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Class 10 certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Class 10 certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate. Age limits count from this date.

demoFields.label: Certificate of Identification number
demoFields.hint: Most Sikkim state posts require it. Get it from Sikkim GO before the closing date.

demoFields.label: Category claimed
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a Sikkim certificate for. The state's reservation categories differ from those elsewhere.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the advertisement's closing date.

demoFields.label: Employment exchange registration number
demoFields.hint: Some advertisements require a live registration. Renew it if it has lapsed.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here.

demoSteps: Get the Certificate of Identification in hand before anything else. Most Sikkim state posts cannot be applied for without it.
Register on the SPSC recruitment portal with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate.
Open the advertisement, apply through the same login, upload the photograph and signature in the sizes stated, and pay the fee.
Print the filled application and keep it with the payment receipt until the recruitment ends.
Download the admit card from the same login and take it with a photo ID.
Results are published on the Commission's site. Document verification is last, where the originals of the COI and category certificate must be produced.
schemes.helpline: Sikkim Public Service Commission, Old Tourism Complex, Gangtok

schemes.title: Tripura e-District — Certificates and Digital Seva
schemes.department: Information Technology Department, Government of Tripura
schemes.brief: Tripura's e-District portal, where income, caste, permanent residence and other certificates are applied for and downloaded, along with a range of departmental services. The same services are available across a counter at a Common Service Centre.
schemes.benefit: Income, caste and permanent residence certificates applied for and downloaded online
eligibility: Resident of Tripura, applying in the sub-division where the family lives
A Scheduled Tribe certificate is issued for the tribes notified for Tripura
A permanent residence certificate needs proof the family has lived in the state for the qualifying period
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Voter card or electricity bill as residence proof
Father's caste or tribe certificate, for a caste certificate
School certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, caste, Scheduled Tribe, permanent residence or a departmental service. Each has its own form and proof.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: For a tribe certificate this decides the case — tribe is traced through the father's family record.

demoFields.label: Tribe or caste claimed
demoFields.hint: Pick from the list notified for Tripura. A tribe notified in another state does not qualify here.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Sub-division / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Sub-Divisional Magistrate of this sub-division signs.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Recorded for the file. It does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on edistrict.tripura.gov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or go to a Common Service Centre, which files it for the notified fee.
Choose the certificate and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card.
Upload the documents. For a tribe certificate, the father's certificate is the paper that matters most.
Submit, pay the fee, and note the application number.
The block staff verify the family, then the Sub-Divisional Magistrate signs the certificate.
Download it from the same login and check the tribe name and your father's name at once, because a correction means applying again.
schemes.helpline: Your Sub-Divisional Magistrate's office, or the District Magistrate's office
